findings.claude_md_rule: Every error path must carry a regression test (CLAUDE.md section 7)
findings.description: processPayment rolls back the transaction when the gateway raises, but no test exercises that path.
findings.evidence: Lines 74-80: except PaymentGatewayError -- no matching test in tests/payments/
findings.failure_scenario: A regression dropping the rollback would leave a partial transaction in the database, undetected.
findings.suggestion: Mock the gateway to raise PaymentGatewayError and assert the transaction is rolled back.
findings.title: Missing test for the payment failure rollback path

findings.description: The spec requires a 422 for a schema violation, but the handler swallows it and returns 200.
findings.evidence: Line 113: return Response(status=200) inside the ValidationError branch
findings.spec_text: A request failing schema validation MUST return 422 Unprocessable Entity.
findings.suggestion: Return a 422 with the validation detail instead of a 200.
findings.title: Handler returns 200 on a validation failure
